In World of Warcraft addons, [[Wikipedia:XML|XML]] files are used to define user interface elements. It is however not required since most functionality is also supported in Lua via the [[Widget API]]. Similarly to Lua files, XML files are referenced from the [[TOC format|TOC]] file.

==Overview==
It's recommended to use an editor like [https://code.visualstudio.com/ VS Code] with the [https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=redhat.vscode-xml Red Hat XML] extension. 

{| class="darktable"
| [[File:XML_schema_01.png|link=]]
|}

* A '''tag''' begins with <code><</code> and ends with <code>></code>; for example {{api.code|<Frame>}}.
* A tag can have '''attributes'''; for example <code><Frame <font color="#ecbc2a">name="ShinyRedApple"</font></code>.
* An '''element''' consists of a start tag, end tag and anything in between; for example {{api.code|<Frame>content</Frame>}}.

===XML schema===
Each XML file consists of a <code>Ui</code> element. The <code>xmlns</code> and related attributes are optional but essential for XML parsers and validation.
<syntaxhighlight lang="xml">
<Ui xmlns="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/ https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/live/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_SharedXML/UI.xsd">
</Ui>
</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="xml">
<!-- can also be formatted like this for readability purposes -->
<Ui xmlns="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/
                        https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/live/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_SharedXML/UI.xsd">
</Ui>
</syntaxhighlight>
{| class="darktable"
|
* {{api.code|xmlns}} declares the default namespace so that all of the nested elements will be namespaced to <code><nowiki>http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/</nowiki></code> which basically means the XML file will be associated with World of Warcraft.
* {{api.code|xmlns:xsi}} declares the <code>http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance</code> namespace and binds it to the <code>xsi</code> prefix. ''(which stands for xml schema instance but you can also just use an arbitrary prefix name like <code>foo</code>)''
* {{api.code|xsi:schemaLocation}} declares whitespace-separated pairs of namespace and [[Wikipedia:XML_Schema_(W3C)|XSD]] files. This means that https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/live/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_SharedXML/UI.xsd will be used with the <code><nowiki>http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/</nowiki></code> namespace for validation and hinting.
|}

===Example===
Shows a texture on the center of the screen.
[[File:API_CreateFrame_mushroom.png|thumb|left|link=|]]
<syntaxhighlight lang="xml">
<Ui xmlns="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/ https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/live/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_SharedXML/UI.xsd">
    <Frame parent="UIParent">
        <Size x="64" y="64"/>
        <Anchors>
            <Anchor point="CENTER"/>
        </Anchors>
        <Layers>
            <Layer level="ARTWORK">
                <Texture file="interface/icons/inv_mushroom_11" setAllPoints="true"/>
            </Layer>
        </Layers>
    </Frame>
</Ui>
</syntaxhighlight>

===PlayerModel===
